description: This file defines a Playwright helper class 'Textarea' for interacting with HTML `<textarea>` elements, providing methods to fill, clear, get value, and check visibility/enabled state, with support for creating instances based on the 'name' attribute.

classes.name: Textarea
classes.description: A helper class for interacting with HTML `<textarea>` elements in Playwright tests, encapsulating locator management and common actions.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a Textarea instance with a Playwright Page and either a selector string or a Locator.

methods.name: fromName
methods.description: Creates a Textarea instance targeting a `<textarea>` element with a specific 'name' attribute.

methods.name: element
methods.description: Returns the Locator associated with the textarea element.

methods.name: fill
methods.description: Fills the textarea with specified text, replacing existing content.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the content of the textarea.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the current value of the textarea.

methods.name: isVisible
methods.description: Checks if the textarea is visible on the page.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the textarea is enabled for interaction.
